name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood summers spent watching Formula 1 races with his grandfather. After earning a degree in Mechanical Engineering from McGill University, he initially worked as a design engineer for a small automotive firm. However, the allure of the racetrack proved too strong, and he transitioned into motorsport, starting as a data analyst for a regional racing team. His meticulous approach and knack for problem-solving quickly propelled him through the ranks, ultimately landing him a role as a race engineer. 

 Jean-Pierre is known for his data-driven approach and his ability to translate complex technical information into actionable insights for the driver. He thrives under pressure and is always looking for innovative solutions to gain a competitive edge. His ambition is to contribute to championship-winning teams and push the boundaries of racing technology.

physical.description: Jean-Pierre has a focused gaze and a lean build, suggesting a disciplined lifestyle.

quirks: Always carries a worn-out copy of 'Fundamentals of Aerodynamics'
Insists on using metric units exclusively, even in the US
Meticulously cleans his workspace before and after every session
